title: eludite.browser.wait input
description: Wait on a tab until something happens, up to `wait_ms` (default 10000, at most 60000): an element matching `css` exists (`for: selector`, answers its ref), the page's text contains `text` (`for: text`), the main frame navigates and loads (`for: navigation`), no request is in flight for 500 ms (`for: network_idle`), a console message matching `pattern` arrives (`for: console`), or `expression` evaluates truthy (`for: function`, polled every 100 ms). Use instead of sleeping after an action that updates the page asynchronously. Not satisfied in time answers `timeout: true`, not a failure. Fails with "no tab" when the browser has no tab: call eludite.browser.tab_open first.

pattern.description: With `for: console`. A substring, or a regular expression between slashes (`/err(or)?/`; Rust regex syntax, `/.../i` for case-insensitive).

expression.description: With `for: function`: JavaScript evaluated in the page; awaited when it returns a promise.

wait_ms.description: How long to wait, in milliseconds (default 10000).

tab.description: The tab: its id from eludite.browser.tabs (`t1`, `t2`, ...). Default: the active tab (the one last opened or selected).
